description: This file defines interfaces related to serialization codecs in the Orleans framework, specifically for generalized and specialized codecs supporting multiple types.

classes.name: IGeneralizedCodec
classes.description: An interface for codecs supporting multiple types, extending IFieldCodec, with a method to check if a type is supported.

classes.name: ISpecializableCodec
classes.description: An interface providing access to codecs for multiple types, including methods to check support and retrieve specialized codecs.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is supported by the codec.

methods.name: GetSpecializedCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec that supports the specified type.
